title: Sqrt(x)
summary: Return the largest nonnegative integer r for which r×r does not exceed x.

contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned int.

statement: Return the largest nonnegative integer r for which r×r does not exceed x. Do not call square-root, power, or exponentiation routines.

examples.explanation: Nine fits but sixteen is too large.
The square root of zero is zero.
46340 squared fits, while 46341 squared does not.

hints: Conceptual: The desired integer separates squares that fit from squares that are too large.
Implementation: Compare mid with x divided by mid to avoid overflowing a square. Preserve the largest feasible candidate.
complexityAnalysis: O(log(x+1)) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
